candidates.statement: Redis reserve_inventory operations time out (~2s) across multiple checkout correlation IDs, causing inventory /v1/reservations 503s, order ReadTimeouts, and gateway /v1/checkout 502s. Gateway metrics show 16 502s and p95 ~2425ms on /v1/checkout with zero 200s.
candidates.uncertainty: Redis-side metrics/logs excluded; cannot confirm whether timeout stems from Redis saturation, network, or inventory client config.

report.explanation: Traces show a consistent chain: redis.reserve_inventory timeouts -> inventory 503 -> order ReadTimeout -> gateway 502 on /v1/checkout, matching the alert's 502s at ~2s. Gateway metrics confirm 502s and elevated p95. Bounded candidate is redis-timeout; Redis-side evidence is still needed to confirm the underlying cause.
missing_evidence: Redis server-side latency/saturation metrics for the incident window
Inventory service logs confirming redis client timeout configuration
